faqs.q: Where can I find information about water licensing and approvals?
faqs.a: You can find information on licensing and approvals through the NSW Government Water Group.

faqs.q: How can I report suspicious or illegal water activity?
faqs.a: You can report suspicious or illegal water activity to the NSW Natural Resources Access Regulator.

faqs.q: Where can I view real-time water data?
faqs.a: Real-time water data is available from Water NSW.
